title: Givaudan: Perfumery drives nine-month growth
summary: Swiss fragrance, flavor and ingredient manufacturer Givaudan reported better-than-expected sales for the first nine months of 2026, with growth accelerating in the third quarter, driven primarily by fine fragrance. Sales totaled CHF 5.89 billion (EUR 6.32 billion) from January to September, up 5.2% on a like-for-like basis, excluding currency effects and acquisitions, and 2.6% in Swiss francs. Analysts surveyed by Swiss news agency AWP had forecast sales of CHF 5.78 billion for the period... - Industry buzz
